keyword: where to watch the launch today

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission launches on April 2, 2026.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Artemis II is scheduled to launch... on Wednesday, April 1, 2026.'; R2: 'Artemis II launch today, April 1'; R3: Launch at 6:35 p.m. EDT on launch day (April 1 context); R7: 'tomorrow, April 1'; R8: 'launch window... Wednesday [April 1]'
verifications.reasoning: All sources specify April 1, 2026, directly contradicting the claim's date.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission launch window opens at 6:24 p.m. EDT on April 2, 2026.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Launch time is 6:24 p.m. ET... April 1, 2026'; R2: 'launch window... opens at 6:24 p.m. ET, April 1'; R7: 'liftoff targeted no earlier than 6:24 p.m. EDT on Wednesday, April 1'; R8: 'launch window... opens at 6:24 p.m. EDT Wednesday [April 1]'
verifications.reasoning: Time matches but date is April 1, 2026, not April 2, making the specific dated claim incorrect.

verifications.claim: Continuous NASA YouTube coverage begins at 7:45 a.m. EDT on April 2, 2026.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Live coverage of tanking operations... at 7:45 a.m. on NASA’s YouTube channel' (April 1 context); R7: 'YouTube coverage begins Wednesday at 7:45 a.m. EDT [April 1]'
verifications.reasoning: Time and platform match but date is April 1, 2026, not April 2.

verifications.claim: Specialized coverage of Artemis II crew suit-up begins on NASA+ at 12:50 p.m. EDT on April 2, 2026.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Full launch coverage begins at 12:50 p.m. on NASA+'; R7: 'NASA+ coverage... beginning at 12:50 p.m. EDT with crew suit-up' (April 1 context)
verifications.reasoning: Time, platform, and content match but date is April 1, 2026, not April 2.

verifications.claim: NASA YouTube provides comprehensive coverage of the Artemis II launch day.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Watch livestreams on: ... NASA’s YouTube channel'; R3: 'Live coverage... at 7:45 a.m. on NASA’s YouTube channel'; R7: 'YouTube coverage begins... 7:45 a.m. EDT... runs continuously through the entire 10-day mission'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm continuous/comprehensive YouTube coverage from early morning through launch day.

verifications.claim: NASA+ streaming provides comprehensive coverage of the Artemis II launch day.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Full launch coverage begins at 12:50 p.m. on NASA+'; R7: 'NASA+ coverage... beginning at 12:50 p.m. EDT with crew suit-up and signing off after Orion’s solar array wings deploy'
verifications.reasoning: NASA+ provides launch day coverage but described as shorter/curated, not fully comprehensive like YouTube's continuous feed.

verifications.claim: NASA.gov provides comprehensive coverage of the Artemis II launch day.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Live launch day updates for NASA’s Artemis II... will be published on this page' (nasa.gov blog with continuous timestamps from 7:44 a.m. through launch)
verifications.reasoning: NASA.gov blog (R3) provides detailed live updates throughout launch day, supporting comprehensive coverage.

verifications.claim: FOX Weather's YouTube channel offers live feeds of the Artemis II launch.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No sources mention FOX Weather or its YouTube channel; Fox News/TV mentioned but not FOX Weather YouTube.

verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state Amazon Prime streams the launch.
